# SlimSAM pretrained model

Source: https://huggingface.co/Xenova/slimsam-77-uniform
Revision:5850ab45f587c112167512ffef949107115e26a0
Apache-2.0. ONNX INT8 conversion supplied by Xenova/Hugging Face, based on SlimSAM and Segment Anything. This application did not train the model or validate its accuracy on textiles. The image encoder and prompt encoder/mask decoder are used for explicit local neural boundary review.

Exact files and SHA-256 values:provenance.json.
